candidates.definition_line: Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges
candidates.face_teaser: Pressure never asks your permission. You’re sharpened by the trials you would never have chosen. You meet the hard thing head-on where others flinch, decisive and hard to rattle. The watch is for when force becomes a reflex on what only needed a lighter hand.
candidates.family_clause: the structure you answer to and grow into

family_element.appetite: challenge, pressure, and the trials that forge you
family_element.notAlone: not control alone, but everything that tests you and steadies you

__ore.note: TG corpus — the K2 generation source (kept per REA_03 §2.4)

rulingRealm.phrase: Survival Instinct / Trauma / Resilience — forged, not developed
rulingRealm.desc: 七杀制伏得宜，反为权贵: "When Seven Killings are properly channeled, they produce genuine authority." The force that presses against the DM without moderation, without asking whether it is ready. What gets produced — when resources are adequate — is character that could only have come from that specific pressure.

gifts: What others carry as developed virtue, this person carries as the residue of surviving something that did not offer the option to fail gracefully
The character that only sustained adversarial pressure without permission produces — it cannot be imitated by those who haven't been through the equivalent
Genuine authority that others recognize as real precisely because it was tested rather than credentialed
shadows: 制者必须有力: the channeling requires significant resources — without them, the same force that refines damages
Does not moderate itself, does not ask whether the moment warrants the full force
The bifurcation is genuine: not a spectrum, not a middle outcome — the pressure either forges or breaks
__ore.hiddenDynamic: What rarely gets named: the quiet exhaustion of having been forged and knowing exactly what it cost. Not pride in the resilience — something quieter, closer to grief about what was required to become this. The question that runs beneath the authority: whether what was built through surviving was worth what was lost in the surviving.

outputs.desc: What others carry as cultivated virtue, you carry as the residue of surviving something that offered no graceful way to fail.
Your character is the kind only sustained pressure produces — it can't be imitated by anyone who hasn't been through the equivalent.
Others recognize your authority as real precisely because it was tested rather than credentialed.

frictions.desc: Channeling the pressure takes real resources; without them, the same force that forges instead damages.
The force doesn't moderate itself or ask whether the moment actually warrants its full weight.
The outcome is genuinely bifurcated — not a spectrum but a fork: the pressure either forges you or breaks you.

career.mechanism: 七杀 → adversarial pressure tolerance, genuine authority under fire
career.text: Exceptional in roles requiring genuine pressure-tolerance and leadership under adversity — emergency work, high-stakes entrepreneurship, competitive performance, crisis management. The authority that comes from demonstrated survival is recognized differently from institutional authority.

relationships.mechanism: 七杀 → intensity, testing without permission, bifurcated outcomes
relationships.text: Relationships shaped by 七杀 involve significant pressure, intensity, or adversity. The bifurcation applies here too: relationships are either deeply forged or significantly damaged. Tends to attract challenging partners or bring intensity that others find difficult to sustain.

wealth.mechanism: 七杀 → high-risk/high-reward, non-moderate financial outcomes
wealth.text: Can generate significant wealth through high-risk, high-consequence situations that others won't enter. The risk: the same non-permission quality that produces exceptional outcomes also produces exceptional losses when resources run out.

health.mechanism: 七杀 → chronic high-pressure operation, DM element depleted by adversarial force
health.text: The body bears the cost of sustained adversarial operation. Even when external pressure subsides, the internal system calibrated for it doesn't easily downregulate.

domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.helping.lived: Hard jobs found you in those years, and you met pressure that would have stopped most people. You rose by handling it, and you learned your strength in the worst weeks.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.heavy.lived: Pressure at work came without pause in those years, from demanding bosses, tight deadlines and fights you had not chosen. You kept going on sheer will, and the few people who stood by you carried you through.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Career.heavy.ahead: Demands pile up at work in these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing survives the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Growth.heavy.lived: Those years tested you more than they taught you, with one hard stretch after another. You grew in spite of the pressure, and you came out tougher and more tired than you expected.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Health.heavy.lived: Strain gathered in your body during those years, in your shoulders, your back and your sleep. You pushed through on nerve alone, and what carried you was a few people who made you stop.
domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.decade_lines.Health.heavy.ahead: Stress sits in your body through these years, in tight shoulders and short nights. Your energy returns whenever sleep and slow meals get their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.

helping.ahead: You take on hard assignments and real pressure in these years, and you rise because of them. You come out of the decade with more authority than you went in with.
helping.lived: Hard tasks found you in those years, and you met pressure that would have stopped most people. You rose by handling it, and you learned your strength in the worst weeks.

heavy.lived: Pressure in your work came without pause in those years, from hard demands, tight deadlines and fights you had not chosen. You kept going on sheer will, and the few people who stood by you carried you through.
heavy.ahead: Demands pile up in your work through these years faster than you can meet them, and a calm week feels like falling behind. Your standing holds through the decade, and you get through by choosing which fights matter.

helping.ahead: You grow fastest in these years through pressure, a hard role or a challenge you choose on purpose. You come out of the decade stronger in the places that used to hold you back.
helping.lived: Challenges shaped you in those years, and each hard test left you more capable than before. You learned to face pressure directly, and the courage you built has stayed with you.

heavy.lived: Those years tested you more than they taught you, with one hard stretch after another. A stubborn refusal to stop kept you going, and you came out tougher and more tired than you expected.
heavy.ahead: Setbacks arrive in these years without warning, and you are pushed before you feel ready. What carries you is the discipline you already have, and you end the decade tougher in ways that show later.

helping.ahead: You carry more pressure in these years, and for once it suits your body. You are fitter and sharper in a demanding decade than in an easy one, and you stay that way while you keep sleeping.
helping.lived: Your body answered strain well in those years, and hard training or hard work made you stronger. You had energy for demanding days, and you recovered fast between them.

heavy.lived: Strain gathered in your body during those years, and it showed first in your sleep. You pushed through on nerve alone, and you got through because a few people made you stop.
heavy.ahead: Pressure costs you sleep and energy through these years, and short nights add up faster than you notice. What carries you is sleep and slow meals given their place in the week, and you recover fast once the pressure lifts.
